scenes.en: Screens all day. No eye check in years?
scenes.ta: நாள் முழுக்க திரை, கண் பரிசோதனை இல்லையா?
scenes.say: Your team stares at screens all day. When did they last get their eyes checked?

scenes.en: At your office, apartment, school or community hall. From 50 people.
scenes.ta: அலுவலகம், குடியிருப்பு, பள்ளியில் கண் முகாம். 50 பேர் முதல்
scenes.say: LenzKare runs eye camps at your office, apartment, school or community hall, for groups of fifty people or more.

scenes.en: Vision and eye power, screen-strain advice, who needs a specialist
scenes.ta: பார்வை, கண் பவர், கண் சோர்வு ஆலோசனை
scenes.say: We check vision and eye power, give screen-strain advice, and tell people if they need to see an eye specialist.

scenes.en: WHO: about 1 billion people have vision problems that were preventable or are not yet treated.
scenes.say: Did you know? The World Health Organization says about one billion people have a vision problem that could have been prevented, or is still not treated. Often it is simply uncorrected power.

scenes.en: Clearer vision, fewer headaches, happier teams.
scenes.ta: தெளிவான பார்வை, குறைந்த தலைவலி, மகிழ்ச்சியான குழு
scenes.say: Clear vision means fewer headaches, less eye strain, and a happier, more productive team.

scenes.ta: ஃப்யூஷன் லென்ஸ் கண்ணாடிக்கு ஒன்று வாங்கினால் ஒன்று இலவசம்
scenes.say: Team members who need glasses get buy one get one free on spectacles with LenzKare Fusion lenses.
